Clean #energy accounted for 10% of global GDP in 2023 - adding around $320 billion to the world economy. 

With the opportunity to leverage current progress on #SDG7 to drive the advancement of other SDGs, how does enhanced access to clean and affordable energy promote socio-economic development, and how can we accelerate this progress? ⚡️
